description: This Java source file defines the main Spring Boot application class 'PostgresDemoApplication' for the ModernRepo project. It performs startup connectivity checks for a PostgreSQL database, logs effective configuration details with obfuscated credentials, and handles initial connection validation with retry logic for protocol or SSL errors.

classes.name: PostgresDemoApplication
classes.description: Main Spring Boot application class that performs startup database connectivity checks for PostgreSQL when the application starts.

methods.name: startupConnectivityCheck
methods.description: Method annotated with @PostConstruct that logs effective datasource configuration, obfuscates credentials, and verifies PostgreSQL connection, including a retry mechanism on certain protocol or SSL errors.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that launches the Spring Boot application.
